title: "NYC Rent and Subway Proximity: Simple Model"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))

library(tidyverse)
```

## Load modeling data

Use the exploration sample and keep only rows with all required variables.

```{r load-data}
modeling_data <- read.csv(
  file.path("data", "processed", "nyc_rent_transit_modeling.csv"),
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

model_df <- modeling_data |>
  filter(analysis_split == "exploration") |>
  drop_na(
    monthly_rent,
    bedrooms,
    bathrooms,
    sqft,
    borough,
    distance_to_subway_m
  )

nrow(model_df)
```

## Fit a simple model

```{r simple-model}
m1 <- lm(
  monthly_rent ~ bedrooms + bathrooms + sqft + borough +
    distance_to_subway_m,
  data = model_df
)

summary(m1)
```

## Perform transformations

```{r model-with-transformations}
m2 <- lm(
  log_monthly_rent ~ bedrooms + bathrooms + sqft + borough +
    log_distance_m,
  data = model_df
)

summary(m2)
```
